parameters.spectrum: local Planck base; renderer may apply a separately documented atmosphere
parameters.inner_boundary: stress-free ISCO; no emission inside the ISCO

disk.lookup: log flux versus log distance from ISCO

raytracer.model: Kerr null geodesics; first opaque prograde circular thin-disk intersection
raytracer.azimuth_and_travel_time: not required by stationary axisymmetric emission; not integrated

camera.model: wavelength-resolved Airy intensity PSF of an unobstructed circular aperture
camera.integration: actual-wavelength trapezoidal quadrature, including half endpoint weights
camera.order: scalar Planck radiance; detector subpixel average; per-wavelength PSF; CIE XYZ; linear sRGB
camera.kernel_quadrature: Gauss-Legendre integration over each detector pixel; more nodes for undersampled kernels
camera.boundary: zero outside supplied input field; crop an overscan margin to avoid missing external light
camera.finite_support: pixel-integrated circular cutoff, normalized to unit sum at each wavelength
camera.exposure_or_tone_mapping: none; caller applies one fixed exposure and display transform

acceleration.method: normalized scalar Planck SVD; absolute amplitude restored before BOX average; RGB-weighted spectral OTF sums
acceleration.exact_zero_rule: same exponent >= 700 cutoff already used by direct planck_lambda; no additional light truncation
acceleration.out_of_domain_policy: direct wavelength-resolved fallback; zero sentinel retained
acceleration.cold_scene_policy: direct fallback when all emitting temperatures are below 2000 K

animation: 85–88 degree cosine view study, i=86.5+1.5cos(2pi phase); independent static observers

display.color_role: calculated visible color for the specified model; fixed display contrast, no automatic white balance
display.source_radiance: diluted shifted Planck spectrum, not bolometric false color
